requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Layer metadata returned polygon geometry, statewide extent, EPSG:4326, parcel_id/countyName fields and GeoJSON support.
Anonymous exact-point query returned one full MultiPolygon with parcel_id 6334100000 and countyName El Paso; no owner, address, titleholder, tax, account or contact fields were requested.

El Paso County parcel layer schema/extent reviewed; bounded exact-point and small surrounding-envelope requests returned zero features because the published layer extent is north of the WUP point. This is a map extent miss, not evidence of parcel absence.
Viewer host did not complete within the bounded request window; no login or bypass was attempted. Official City documentation was used for the viewer lead.

qualityAssessment.identityReadiness: native parcel_id is present in the public source schema and retained as the sole sample identity; runtime admission remains held pending independent serial review

nextStep: Serial reviewer should independently confirm source custody, El Paso County coverage, parcel_id identity semantics, CRS handling, geometry validity and update behavior before any adapter qualification.
